name: YOLOv4
paper_title: YOLOv4: Optimal Speed and Accuracy of Object Detection
license_interpretation: Darknet's bundled NOTICE quotes its own license in full: "Darknet is public domain. Do whatever you want with it." That covers both the architecture and the pretrained weights LibreYOLO converts from it, with no attribution requirement and no restriction on commercial use. LibreYOLO's own code around this architecture is MIT.
bibtex_verified: 2026-08-08, copied verbatim from the Citation section of the upstream README at AlexeyAB/darknet on branch master (the same entry is mirrored in pjreddie/darknet's README). Cross-checked against the arXiv API for 2004.10934: three authors in the same order, Alexey Bochkovskiy, Chien-Yao Wang and Hong-Yuan Mark Liao, one version dated 2020-04-23, no journal reference and primary class cs.CV, so the @misc form the authors publish still matches the record. Do not hand-edit; a wrong citation misattributes someone's work.
